g.title: cluster_layer2

g.title: cluster_layer6
g.text: Layer 6: Physical Motor & Rotor Mechanics (Continuous Nature)

g.title: uart_rx
g.text: Guarded by valid_ms watchdog timer (300 ms)

g.text: Calculates Gate Duty Cycles (Ta, Tb, Tc)
